title: Patience of God
definition: The patience of God is His holy restraint and longsuffering toward sinners, delaying judgment and giving opportunity for repentance.
summary: God is patient, slow to anger, and merciful toward sinners.
christFocus: Jesus displays divine patience by receiving sinners and calling them to repentance.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's patience does not mean He approves of sin or will never judge. It means He is slow to anger and merciful, giving time for repentance according to His purposes.

His patience is seen throughout Scripture as He bears with rebellious people, warns them, sends prophets, and calls them back.

In Christ, divine patience becomes deeply personal. Sinners who deserve judgment are invited to repentance and mercy.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often mistake God's patience for indifference or permission to continue in sin. This doctrine matters because patience is mercy meant to lead to repentance, not presumption.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not abuse God's patience. Repent quickly, give thanks for mercy, and show patience toward others as one who has received patience from God.
